description.value:
Mud Wall. A reactive defensive jutsu.

Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet of you would be hit by a ranged Strike or a spell with the fire, water, electricity, or air trait that targets a single creature or area you can shield.

A spire of compressed mud bursts from the ground between the attacker and the target. The defender treats the triggering attack/spell as if they had greater cover (+4 circumstance bonus to AC or saving throw). After resolving, the mud spire collapses, leaving the central square as difficult terrain for 1 round.

system.requirements: exposed earth or stone within range
